Revine 0.9.0, 1.0.2 and 1.0.4 are benign React/Vite scaffolding CLIs.
The archives contain no installation lifecycle hook, remote payload, secret
collection or exfiltration. Interactive Git commit message interpolation is
unsafe shell construction, but does not establish malicious intent.

The batch filename observation retains its Windows/JavaScript scope and matcher
while moving from file writing to filename extensions. All four exact consumers
are updated; no ancestor directory selectors reference the old writing leaf.
Filename references must not alone imply file creation.

React createElement imports do not establish DOM creation. The DOM umbrella now
uses the canonical document.createElement call and contextual fragment call.
Spaced identifier subtraction excludes CSS class tokens recovered as subtraction
in JSX. Unspaced subtraction is intentionally outside this narrower observation.

The fixtures and cases.json record positive, near-miss and overlapping claims.

Run python3 testdata/taxonomy/revine-triage/check.py <scratch-control-directory>
from the traits root. Controls are copied outside the intentionally excluded
test tree before evaluation.
